service: dpss-ts-dev-middleware

useDotenv: true

custom:
  # FFmpeg layer ARNs - Using community-maintained layers
  ffmpegLayer:
    us-east-1: arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:145266761615:layer:ffmpeg:4
    us-west-1: arn:aws:lambda:us-west-1:145266761615:layer:ffmpeg:4
    us-west-2: arn:aws:lambda:us-west-2:145266761615:layer:ffmpeg:4
    eu-west-1: arn:aws:lambda:eu-west-1:145266761615:layer:ffmpeg:4
    eu-central-1: arn:aws:lambda:eu-central-1:145266761615:layer:ffmpeg:4
    ap-southeast-1: arn:aws:lambda:ap-southeast-1:145266761615:layer:ffmpeg:4
    ap-northeast-1: arn:aws:lambda:ap-northeast-1:145266761615:layer:ffmpeg:4
    default: arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:145266761615:layer:ffmpeg:4

package:
  patterns:
    - '!template.yaml'
    - '!samconfig.toml'
    - '!.aws-sam/**'
    - '!.serverless/**'

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs22.x
  region: us-west-2
  stage: ${opt:stage, 'dev'}
  profile: lac-customer
  memorySize: 1024
  timeout: 30
  versionFunctions: true


  # HTTP API CORS Configuration
  httpApi:
    cors:
      allowedOrigins:
        -        - '*'
      allowedHeaders:
        - Content-Type
        - Authorization
        - X-Amz-Date
        - X-Api-Key
        - X-Amz-Security-Token
      allowedMethods:
        - GET
        - POST
        - PUT
        - DELETE
        - OPTIONS
      allowCredentials: false
      maxAge: 3600
  
  # layers:
  #   - ${self:custom.ffmpegLayer.${self:provider.region}, self:custom.ffmpegLayer.default}
  
  # IAM Role for Lambda - Version 4 Syntax
  iam:
    role:
      statements:
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - dynamodb:Query
            - dynamodb:Scan
            - dynamodb:GetItem
            - dynamodb:PutItem
            - dynamodb:UpdateItem
            - dynamodb:DeleteItem
          Resource: 
            - "arn:aws:dynamodb:${self:provider.region}:*:table/${self:service}-${self:provider.stage}-*"
        - Effect: Allow
          Action:
            - logs:CreateLogGroup
            - logs:CreateLogStream
            - logs:PutLogEvents
          Resource: "*"

  # Environment variables
  environment:
    LOG_LEVEL: ${env:LOG_LEVEL, 'INFO'}
    AGENTS_TABLE_NAME: !Ref AgentsTable
    CAPTURES_TABLE_NAME: !Ref CapturesTable
    SUBSCRIPTIONS_TABLE_NAME: !Ref SubscriptionsTable
    WX_TOKEN_TABLE_NAME: !Ref WxTokenTable
    CAWS_TOKEN_TABLE_NAME: !Ref CawsTokenTable
    # AWS_REGION is automatically available in Lambda environment
    
    # Webex Configuration
    WXCLIENT_ID: ${env:WXCLIENT_ID, ''}
    WXCLIENT_SECRET: ${env:WXCLIENT_SECRET, ''}
    WXCLIENT_ORGID: ${env:WXCLIENT_ORGID, ''}
    WXAUTH_URL: ${env:WXAUTH_URL, ''}
    WXCC_WEBHOOK_SECRET: ${env:WXCC_WEBHOOK_SECRET, ''}
    WXCC_REFRESH_TOKEN: ${env:WXCC_REFRESH_TOKEN, ''}
    
    # CA Configuration
    CACLIENT_ID: ${env:CACLIENT_ID, ''}
    CACLIENT_SECRET: ${env:CACLIENT_SECRET, ''}
    CACLIENT_SCOPE: ${env:CACLIENT_SCOPE, ''}
    CACASEURL: ${env:CACASEURL, ''}
    CASTOREURL: ${env:CASTOREURL, ''}
    CAAUTH_URL: ${env:CAAUTH_URL, ''}
    
    # Other Configuration
    WEBHOOK_URL: ${env:WEBHOOK_URL, ''}
    IDLE_TIMER: ${env:IDLE_TIMER, '0'}
    
    # FFmpeg Configuration for Lambda Layer
    FFMPEG_PATH: /opt/bin/ffmpeg
    FFPROBE_PATH: /opt/bin/ffprobe

functions:
  api:
    handler: lambda.handler
    memorySize: 1024 # Increased memory for FFmpeg processing
    timeout: 29      # Adjusted to match HTTP API maximum 29s timeout
    events:
      # API Gateway endpoints
      - httpApi:
          path: /
          method: GET
      
      # Webhook endpoints
      - httpApi:
          path: /webhook/webhook
          method: POST
      - httpApi:
          path: /webhook/status
          method: GET
      - httpApi:
          path: /webhook/subscribe
          method: GET
      - httpApi:
          path: /webhook/unsubscribe
          method: GET
      
      # Token endpoints
      - httpApi:
          path: /token/{proxy+}
          method: ANY
      
      # Telephonic Signature endpoints
      - httpApi:
          path: /telephonic-signature/pauseResume
          method: POST
      - httpApi:
          path: /telephonic-signature/api/status
          method: GET
      - httpApi:
          path: /telephonic-signature/api/task/{taskId}
          method: GET
      
      # Database test endpoints
      - httpApi:
          path: /test/database
          method: GET
      - httpApi:
          path: /test/tables
          method: GET
      # Audio conversion test endpoint
      - httpApi:
          path: /test/audio-check
          method: GET
      
      # Recording log endpoint - query agent calls by date range
      - httpApi:
          path: /recording-log
          method: GET

  # Token refresh function - triggered by EventBridge every 15 minutes
  tokenRefresh:
    handler: token-refresh.handler
    description: Refreshes WX and CA tokens periodically
    memorySize: 256
    timeout: 60
    events:
      - schedule:
          rate: rate(15 minutes)
          enabled: true
          description: 'Refresh WX and CA tokens every 15 minutes'

resources:
  Resources:
    # Agents DynamoDB Table
    # Composite key: taskId (partition) + recordId (sort)
    # Each pause/resume pair is a separate item; all pairs for a call share the same taskId.
    AgentsTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: ${self:service}-${self:provider.stage}-Agents
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: taskId
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: recordId
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: taskId
            KeyType: HASH
          - AttributeName: recordId
            KeyType: RANGE
        Tags:
          - Key: Environment
            Value: ${self:provider.stage}
          - Key: Service
            Value: ${self:service}

    # Captures DynamoDB Table
    CapturesTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: ${self:service}-${self:provider.stage}-Captures
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: taskId
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: taskId
            KeyType: HASH
        Tags:
          - Key: Environment
            Value: ${self:provider.stage}
          - Key: Service
            Value: ${self:service}

    # Subscriptions DynamoDB Table
    SubscriptionsTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: ${self:service}-${self:provider.stage}-Subscriptions
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: id
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: id
            KeyType: HASH
        Tags:
          - Key: Environment
            Value: ${self:provider.stage}
          - Key: Service
            Value: ${self:service}

    # WxToken DynamoDB Table
    WxTokenTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: ${self:service}-${self:provider.stage}-WxToken
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: id
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: id
            KeyType: HASH
        Tags:
          - Key: Environment
            Value: ${self:provider.stage}
          - Key: Service
            Value: ${self:service}

    # CawsToken DynamoDB Table
    CawsTokenTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        TableName: ${self:service}-${self:provider.stage}-CawsToken
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: id
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: id
            KeyType: HASH
        Tags:
          - Key: Environment
            Value: ${self:provider.stage}
          - Key: Service
            Value: ${self:service}

  Outputs:
    ApiUrl:
      Description: API Gateway URL
      Value: !Sub https://${HttpApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
    
    AgentsTableName:
      Description: Agents DynamoDB Table Name
      Value: !Ref AgentsTable
    
    CapturesTableName:
      Description: Captures DynamoDB Table Name
      Value: !Ref CapturesTable
    
    SubscriptionsTableName:
      Description: Subscriptions DynamoDB Table Name
      Value: !Ref SubscriptionsTable

plugins:
  - serverless-offline
